title: Logic and Knowledge Representation
overview: Represent facts about the world in formal logic and derive new conclusions through inference.
objectives: Apply resolution or model checking to small knowledge bases

method.title: Propositional logic
method.body: Statements are true or false and combine with AND, OR, NOT, and implication.

method.title: First-order logic
method.body: Adds objects, predicates, and quantifiers, enabling statements like 'all humans are mortal'.

method.title: Entailment and inference
method.body: KB entails a sentence if it is true in every model of KB; sound inference procedures only derive entailed sentences.

method.title: Knowledge representation
method.body: Ontologies, semantic networks, and knowledge graphs organize concepts and relationships for reasoning.

playground.starterCode:
from itertools import product
def entails():
    for p, q in product([False, True], repeat=2):
        kb = (not p or q) and p
        if kb and not q: return False
    return True
print('KB {P->Q, P} entails Q:', entails())
